description: American Society of Civil Engineers - Publications on Climate Change is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE). ASCE offers publications documenting the latest in civil engineering practice and research. Their scholarly publications include books, peer-reviewed journals, conference proceedings, and magazines. Browse publications that address water infrastructure and the impacts of climate change. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Flooding – General, Water Quality. Assets: Economy, Energy and Utilities, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
